description: Deaf sign language of Hong Kong and Macau
extract: Hong Kong Sign Language, abbreviated as HKSL, is the deaf sign language of Hong Kong and Macau. It derived from the southern dialect of Chinese Sign Language, but is now an independent, mutually unintelligible language.
